# Assessment Facts Overview

This directory contains supplementary architecture, dependency, service, data, configuration, and workflow documents for the versioned assessment report.

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) | Two-layer application and component architecture diagrams with technology and component inventories. |
| [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) | Declared NuGet dependencies grouped by category, compatibility notes, and test dependency findings. |
| [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) | Page routes, in-process catalog service contracts, communication patterns, and request sequence. |
| [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) | Database configuration, catalog entity relationships, persistence methods, caching, and data classification. |
| [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) | Configuration sources, build/runtime profiles, settings, secrets, feature flags, and framework versions. |
| [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) | Catalog domain entities, create/update/delete workflows, and business rules. |
